title: Add an appointment form that opens WhatsApp with pre-filled booking details

requirements.text: Add a new "Appointment" (booking) form UI on the landing page that collects basic booking details and, on submit, opens a WhatsApp chat to https://wa.me/918000262644 with the form details pre-filled in the message text (no backend storage).

quotes: Appointment form banavva nu che je dairect mara WhatsApp numbar ma khule

acceptanceCriteria: A new, clearly labeled section is available on the page for booking (English-only user-facing text).
The form includes at minimum: Customer Name, Phone Number, Service (select from existing services), Area/Location, Preferred Date, Preferred Time, and Notes/Message.
Submitting the form opens WhatsApp to https://wa.me/918000262644 with a URL-encoded pre-filled message that includes all entered fields in a readable format.
The feature works on mobile and desktop (on desktop it opens web.whatsapp.com via the wa.me link as supported by the platform/browser).
No data is persisted to the backend; no Motoko changes are required for this feature.

requirements.text: Add basic client-side validation for the appointment form and show inline, non-intrusive error messages in English when required fields are missing or invalid (e.g., empty name, invalid phone number).

quotes: Appointment form banavva nu che je dairect mara WhatsApp numbar ma khule

acceptanceCriteria: Required fields cannot be submitted while invalid; validation messages are shown near the corresponding inputs.
Validation does not block the rest of the page or break existing CTAs/links.
Error messages are English-only and concise.

requirements.text: Add a prominent way to access the appointment form from the existing landing page flow (e.g., an additional button/link near the Hero CTAs or a navigation link) without removing or changing any existing Call/WhatsApp/Instagram/Google Business Profile CTA destinations.

quotes: Appointment form banavva nu che je dairect mara WhatsApp numbar ma khule

acceptanceCriteria: Existing CTAs and their destinations remain unchanged (tel:+918000262644, https://wa.me/918000262644, Instagram link, and Google Business Profile link).
A new link/button scrolls to (or otherwise reveals) the appointment form section and is visible on both mobile and desktop.
All new visible text remains English-only.

constraints: Do not change any existing CTA destinations: tel:+918000262644, https://wa.me/918000262644, https://www.instagram.com/magical_sofa_cleaning?igsh=MW42bHIweG9oZDV0bQ==, https://share.google/Nex4Ll5OOIXAVyXjZ.
Do not add any backend persistence or external APIs for the appointment feature; WhatsApp deep-linking must be done purely via a wa.me URL with URL-encoded text.
Use English for all user-facing text.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Building an admin panel or storing appointments in a database/canister.
Adding any AI/chat/automation behavior to the appointment flow.
